alate: Alate brownish throughout, pronotum yellow, wings pale brown. Fontanelle dot-like and slightly raised, antennae 19–20 segments. Forewing scale larger than the hindwing scale, the two widely separated, the wing scales densely setose, the media with rather many branches. Tarsi 4-segmented, tibial spur formula 3:2:2. Head narrow anteriorly and broad posteriorly, somewhat oval, head-width index about 0.80, head index about 0.70; frontal peaks flat or slightly raised, not elevated above the dorsal surface of the occiput, slightly depressed between them; mandibles rather straight, labrum ligulate.
soldier: Head of the soldier yellow, antennae pale yellow, mandibles brownish, thorax and abdomen pale yellowish white. Head capsule rectangular, lateral margins nearly parallel, frontal region flat. Labrum somewhat oval, the transparent area at the labral tip rather long and triangular, apical, lateral apical and subapical setae all present. Mandibles rather slender and elongate, the apex rather straight. Ten setae along the margin of the lacinia. Antennae 15–16 segments. Postmentum rather slender, the ratio of its narrowest part to the head width about 1:9. Anterior margin of the pronotum arcuate on both sides and incised in the middle, lateral margins gently sloping posteriorly, posterior margin shallowly concave in the middle; setae in the middle region of the thoracic tergites: more than 20 on the pronotum, about 10 on the mesonotum and fewer than 10 on the metanotum.
